description: Track Schengen 90/180 and tax-residency days. Nothing leaves your phone. Nomad Days counts your days abroad so you stay within visa-free limits and tax-residency thresholds. Estimates only, not legal or tax advice. Rules change, so check official sources before you travel. Log your trips (country, arrival and departure). The app shows, for each region you've visited: * days used and days left * the last day you can safely stay * when you can come back Rules included * Schengen Area: 90 days in any 180 * United Kingdom: up to 6 months per visit, and the Statutory Residence Test for each tax year (6 April to 5 April) * United States: 90 days per entry (Visa Waiver Program), and the substantial presence test You can add your own rules for countries that aren't bundled yet: a limit per visit, a rolling window (for example 90 days in 180), or a tax-days threshold. Plan ahead Add future trips as Booked or Maybe and see straight away whether they fit: * the first day a trip would break a rule, or how many days you'd have to spare * how many tax days you'd have left in each country after the trip * Booked trips count toward each other; a Maybe trip is checked on its own, so you can try ideas without affecting anything else * a reminder a week before a booked trip that wouldn't fit, and "Did you go?" on the day it starts, so your log stays accurate UK sufficient ties Spending fewer than 183 days in the UK can still make you UK tax resident if you have enough UK ties. Answer a few yes/no questions (family, accommodation, work, and whether you were UK resident before), each with a plain-English explanation. The app also works out the 90-day and country ties from the trips you log and shows the number of UK days that would make you resident this tax year. Private by design * No accounts, no servers, no analytics, no ads * Your data is encrypted on the device (SQLCipher, AES-256) * Backups are encrypted files that you export and keep, protected by a passphrase only you know Reminders are scheduled on the device and don't use Google services.
